integrity: The proof is self-contained, distinguishes weighted Hilbert sequence operators from analytic-function Hilbert operators, and makes no claim to independent validation. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Assumes bounded magnitudes that are uniformly slowly oscillating on each fixed multiplicative window; no arbitrary-coefficient formula, endpoint exponent assertion, or independent audit. Literature overlap from additional limit-operator formulations remains possible.
title: Exact essential norm for slowly oscillating generalized Hilbert matrices on \(\ell^p\)
